services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs

services.desc: Old or dangerous fuseboxes replaced with modern, safety-compliant units. Improves safety and allows you to add modern appliances.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Can't locate an electrical fault? We use diagnostic equipment to pinpoint problems quickly, saving you time and money on guesswork.

about_pullquote: I started Earth Electrical because I hated seeing customers ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: Earth Electrical has been serving Nottingham for 18 years. We were founded on a simple belief: honest work at fair prices, no cowboy tactics. Over that time, we've completed more than 2,500 jobs, from emergency callouts to full house rewires, and built a reputation for turning up on time and getting the job right first time.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we explain what's wrong, quote upfront, and stick to it. We're NICEIC-approved, insured, and qualified to handle everything from a blown socket to a full commercial install. Whether you're in New Basford or across Nottingham, you'll get the same honest service and competitive pricing.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a problem with the electrics in my kitchen and was worried it'd be expensive. Called Earth Electrical and they came out within an hour. Turned out it was just a loose connection, took 10 minutes to fix, and they only charged for the callout. Brilliant service, no messing about.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Got our whole house rewired last year. The team was professional, tidy, and actually explained what they were doing. Finished on time, on budget, and came with a 10-year guarantee. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Emergency call at 11pm — kitchen electrics were arcing. They picked up straight away, came out within 45 minutes, and had it sorted by midnight. Fair price too, considering the time. You don't forget service like that.
reviews.author: James L.
